faqs.a:
The authority to establish and implement a cross-connection control program is derived
               from the city's powers and authority as a home rule city under articles 15 and 35
               of Title 31 of the Colorado Revised Statutes, from C.R.S. § 25-1-114(1)(h), and from
               the International Plumbing Code as adopted and amended by the city. This program is
               conducted under Regulation 11 of the Colorado Primary Drinking Water Regulations issued
               by Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment at 5 C.C.R. 1002-11, as may
               be amended from time to time.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
